name: reno-layouts
description: Edit measured layouts, research product specifications and export construction-stage diagrams using the open Reno Layouts site's WebMCP tools.

interface.shortDescription: Edit measured plans and research fixture specifications.
interface.longDescription: Three lean skills for the open Reno Layouts site: apply measured layout changes, submit sourced product specifications for human review, and compose construction-stage diagrams and specification sheets from the one project model. Requires a browser surface exposing the site's WebMCP tools and an open project. Product research also needs browsing or document-reading tools.
defaultPrompt: Apply my measured changes to the open Reno Layouts plan.
Research my named Reno Layouts product request.
Export stage diagrams for my Reno Layouts bathroom.
